title.narrative: By 2030, Indigenous and Community Conserved Areas (ICCAs) are established in Malaysia and formally recognised through multistakeholder engagement and efforts led by indigenous and local communities.

description.narrative: By 2030, Indigenous and Community Conserved Areas (ICCAs) are established in Malaysia and formally recognised through multistakeholder engagement and efforts led by indigenous and local communities that effectively promote the conservation of biodiversity, preservation of indigenous cultures and enhancement of local peoples livelihoods and wellbeing, thus contributing to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals 1 (no poverty), 2 (zero hunger), 5 (gender equality), 8 (decent work and economic growth), 14 (life below water) and 15 (life on land).
